title: The Dialogue of Ice and Leaf

features.name: frost-memory
features.desc-on-touch: Where ice learned to remember being water. The shape it holds remembers the shape it gave. Cold waiting for warmth to remember it was always here.

features.name: leaf-counting
features.desc-on-touch: Budding and falling, budding and falling—each cycle a word in a conversation that never ends because both speakers are the same season.

features.name: threshold-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Water that cannot decide: is it frozen or flowing? The space where both answers are briefly true at once.

features.name: turning-point
features.desc-on-touch: The exact moment when the year's direction reverses. Neither ice nor leaf claims it—both bow to it as the place where they trade places.

inscription: here ice and leaf maintain their argument perfectly: each one could be proved wrong only if the other agreed

file.name: Season_Dialogue_Biennial_Recording.wav
file.note: Two-year field recording from the same tree—March to March, playing both years layered. They answer each other
